questions.question: A, B, C, D, K, L, M and N are sitting around a square table facing the centre of the table (but not necessarily in the same order). Some of them are sitting at the corners while some are sitting at the exact centre of the sides.N sits second to the right of M. Only three people sit between L and A when counted from the left of L. L is an immediate neighbour of M. Only three people sit between M and D when counted from the left of M. M sits at one of the corners. C sits to the immediate right of N. N is not an immediate neighbour of A. K is not an immediate neighbour of A.What is the position of M with respect to B?3178
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Second to the right) है।

Zahir starts from point A and drives 2 km towards south. He takes a left turn and drives 3 km and stops at point B. Harsh starts from point X, which is 5 km to the east of point A and drives 3 km towards east. He then takes a right turn and drives 2 km to reach a point Y. What is the shortest distance between point B and point Y? (All turns are 90° turns only.)3204

किसी विशिष्ट कूट भाषा में,

‘A + B’ का अर्थ है कि ‘A, B का पिता है’,
‘A – B’ का अर्थ है कि ‘A, B की माता है’,
‘A $ B’ का अर्थ है कि ‘A, B की पत्नी है’,
‘A % B’ का अर्थ है कि ‘A, B की बहन है’ और
‘A # B’ का अर्थ है कि ‘A, B का पति है’।

निम्नलिखित में से किसका अर्थ है कि D, Z की माता की बहन है?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (P # D % Q – Z) है।

A statement is followed by two assumptions numbered I and II. An assumption is something supposed or taken for granted. You have to consider the statement and the following assumptions and decide which of the assumptions is implicit/valid in the statement.Statement: ‘If it is that easy to become a teacher, I don’t want to pursue it as a career’.Assumption:I. One wants to pursue a thing which is difficult to earn.II. One must try to pursue a good career.
options: Both Assumptions I and II are valid.
Neither Assumption I nor II is valid.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Only Assumption I is valid.) है।
